title: Tiles Shop Near Me in Lahore: Visit Pak Clay's Walton Road Showroom
excerpt: Where to find a clay tiles shop in Lahore, what you can see at Pak Clay's Walton Road office, opening hours and what to bring.
meta_title: Clay Tiles Shop in Lahore: Walton Road Visit Guide
meta_description: Find the Pak Clay clay and terracotta tiles shop on Walton Road, Lahore: hours, what to bring and how to get a free sample.
answer_box: The Pak Clay clay tiles shop is on Walton Road, opposite Packages Mall Gate 2, Lahore, and our contact page lists Monday to Saturday 9am to 9pm and Sunday 1pm to 6pm. Bring photos, rough measurements and your wall colour, view samples, and confirm hours on WhatsApp first.
ai_summary: Pak Clay Tiles has a head office on Walton Road, opposite Packages Mall Gate 2, Lahore, where you can see clay, terracotta and khaprail samples. Bring photos and rough measurements, take free samples home, and ask for a dated written quote rather than relying on an undated price. Confirm opening hours on WhatsApp before you travel.
author: Pak Clay Team

faqs.question: Where is the Pak Clay tiles shop in Lahore?
faqs.answer: Our head office is on Walton Road, opposite Packages Mall Gate 2, Lahore. Call or message +92 300 4617715 if you need directions.

faqs.question: What are the opening hours?
faqs.answer: Our contact page lists Monday to Saturday, 9am to 9pm, and Sunday, 1pm to 6pm. Confirm on WhatsApp first, as hours can change around public holidays.

faqs.question: How much do clay tiles cost at your shop?
faqs.answer: Prices depend on size, thickness, shape, finish, quantity, season and delivery distance, and may be quoted per piece or per square foot. Ask for a written quote with the unit, inclusions and date.

faqs.question: Is a clay tiles shop better than a general tiles market?
faqs.answer: A general market offers more brands, while a maker's shop offers deeper knowledge of clay, firing and fixing. Many buyers visit both and use clay samples as their benchmark.

faqs.question: How do I get a free sample if I cannot visit?
faqs.answer: Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with your city, area and use. We will suggest suitable products and offer a free sample.
